description: nhflow_1d_si_nh_standing with the fourth-order horizontal operators: the cell predictor to the faces and the face terms to the cells with (-1, 9, 9, -1)/16, the explicit -delta^2/12 part of the gradient of eta and of the phi face terms; the two cells next to each wall keep the second-order terms. Since A 508 was retired (always fourth order on one Cartesian grid) this is the run of nhflow_1d_si_nh_standing.
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI_ho: ho_begin, ho_face, ho_cell, ho_gradient, ho_predictor, ho_cell_gravity
nhflow_momentum_SI_nh: ho_phi_corr, ho_phi_add, nh_cell with four faces
band LU with the explicit phi face terms
